input: # divergent.tsv — where this repo's ports DISAGREE, executed by the port
# that diverges.
#   input  Feed XML source. Escapes \n \r \t \\ are decoded, as in
#          test/spec.
#   ts,go,rust
#          what each port produces: a JSON value, or ERROR:<fragment>.
#          As everywhere in this repo the text after ERROR: is a fragment
#          of the MESSAGE, not an error code — see test/AGENTS.md.
#   why    what is wrong, and where the repair lives.
# NOT A FIXTURE. A fixture fails when behaviour REGRESSES. This fails BOTH
# ways: when a port is repaired to agree with the others, the row still
# claims they differ, so the suite goes red and names the row to delete. A
# divergence recorded as a passing test of current behaviour survives its
# own repair, and the record then describes something that no longer
# happens with nothing red.
# This file sits in test/ rather than test/spec/ on purpose. Both parity
# runners enumerate every .tsv under test/spec and read the SECOND column
# header to decide what the file asserts, so a register dropped in there
# would be refused by all three of them.
# Only the Rust suite reads it today (rs/tests/divergent_test.rs). The
# TypeScript and Go halves would read the `ts` and `go` columns of this
# same file; both rows below are about the Rust port alone, so neither
# half would have anything to report yet.
# MEASURED 2026-09-21 against the sibling checkouts, by running each port.
# --- The namespace diagnostics lose their message in Rust ----------------
# Both rows are the same defect, in tabnas/xml's RUST crate, and they
# reproduce with `tabnas_xml` alone — no feed involved:
#   let options = XmlOptions { strict_namespaces: true, ..Default::default() };
# make_with(&options).parse(r#""#).unwrap_err().detail
#   // "namespace resolution failed", not the template for the code
# xml/rs/src/lib.rs `register_refs` raises the namespace failure from
# `@xml-bc`. It marks the current token bad, which interpolates the
# message template for the code, EXCEPT when the context has no current
# token — at document close it has none, so the fallback
# `ActionError::new(code, "namespace resolution failed")` runs and the
# detail is that literal string. The CODE is right in every runtime
# (`unbound_prefix`, `invalid_namespace_uri`) and the template text is
# right in the crate; only this raise path never reaches it.
# Repair belongs in tabnas/xml (rs), not here. The two rows come off this
# file and go back to passing in test/spec/xml-layer.tsv the day it lands,
# which is what the exemption list in rs/tests/parity_test.rs is for.
<feed xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom"><dc:language>en</dc:language></feed>

go: ERROR:element or attribute uses an undeclared namespace prefix
